ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length side view with the camera at waist height, her body in clean profile, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
